     fi
 
+# MiniMax MSA (https://github.com/MiniMax-AI/MSA, MIT), editable because prefill compiles
+# against its CUTLASS submodule; installed last so nothing overwrites its top-level packages.
+# Its MSA-v1 monokernel plugin (integrations/sglang) registers --monokernel-backend msa, inert
+# unless a server passes the flag; commits that predate the plugin skip it.
+ARG MSA_COMMIT
+RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cache/pip \
+    set -eu; \
+    if [ -z "${MSA_COMMIT}" ]; then \
+        echo 'WARNING: MSA_COMMIT is empty; the MSA kernels are not installed' >&2; \
+    else \
+        printf '%s\n' "${MSA_COMMIT}" | grep -Eq '^[0-9a-f]{40}$'; \
+        git init /sgl-workspace/minimax-msa; \
+        git -C /sgl-workspace/minimax-msa remote add origin https://github.com/MiniMax-AI/MSA.git; \
+        git -C /sgl-workspace/minimax-msa fetch --depth 1 origin "${MSA_COMMIT}"; \
+        git -C /sgl-workspace/minimax-msa checkout --detach FETCH_HEAD; \
+        git -C /sgl-workspace/minimax-msa submodule update --init --recursive; \
+        python3 -m pip install --no-deps -e /sgl-workspace/minimax-msa; \
+        test -f /sgl-workspace/minimax-msa/third_party/cutlass/include/cutlass/cutlass.h; \
+        python3 -c "import importlib.metadata as m; d = m.packages_distributions(); \
+bad = {k: d.get(k) for k in ('inference', 'datas', 'msa_v1') if d.get(k) != ['minimax-msa']}; \
+assert not bad, f'MSA top-level packages are shadowed or missing: {bad}'"; \
+        if [ -f /sgl-workspace/minimax-msa/integrations/sglang/pyproject.toml ]; then \
+            python3 -m pip install --no-deps -e /sgl-workspace/minimax-msa/integrations/sglang; \
+            python3 -c "from importlib.metadata import entry_points; \
+assert any(e.name == 'msa' for e in entry_points(group='sglang.srt.plugins')), 'MSA monokernel plugin not registered'"; \
+        else \
+            echo "MSA ${MSA_COMMIT} has no SGLang monokernel plugin; --monokernel-backend msa is unavailable" >&2; \
+        fi; \
+    fi
+
 # Set workspace directory
 WORKDIR /sgl-workspace/sglang

+"""HiCache host mirrors of the MiniMax M3.1 NVFP4 main and index page rows.
+
+Each device sub-pool stores one ``row_bytes`` row per (layer, page); its host
+mirror keeps rows of the same width, so one page of one layer is a single
+contiguous copy on both sides. Main and index share host page indices.
+"""

+from __future__ import annotations

+import logging
+import threading
+
+import numpy as np
+import torch

+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.device_pool_info import PageRowBufferInfo
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.pool_host.base import HostKVCache, host_memory_budget_bytes
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.pool_host.common import (
+    ALLOC_MEMORY_FUNCS,
+    get_allocator_from_storage,
+)
+from sglang.srt.utils import is_cuda

+_is_cuda = is_cuda()
+if _is_cuda:
+    from sgl_kernel.kvcacheio import transfer_embedding_ranges_direct
+
+logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+
+_LAYOUTS = ("layer_first", "page_first", "page_first_direct")
+# Bounded batches let the copy engine start while later ones are built.
+_DIRECT_BATCH_ENTRIES = 4096
+
+
+def _merge_ranges(src_rows: np.ndarray, dst_rows: np.ndarray):
+    """Coalesce row pairs that are consecutive on both sides into runs."""
+    if src_rows.size == 0:
+        return [], [], []
+    breaks = np.flatnonzero((np.diff(src_rows) != 1) | (np.diff(dst_rows) != 1)) + 1
+    starts = np.concatenate(([0], breaks))
+    lengths = np.diff(np.concatenate((starts, [src_rows.size])))
+    return src_rows[starts].tolist(), dst_rows[starts].tolist(), lengths.tolist()
+
+
+class MiniMaxM3Nvfp4IndexKPoolHost(HostKVCache):
+    """HiCache sidecar mirroring the packed index K page rows."""
+
+    storage_objects_per_page = 1
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        buffer_info: PageRowBufferInfo,
+        anchor_host: HostKVCache,
+        layout: str,
+        pin_memory: bool = True,
+        device: str = "cpu",
+        allocator_type: str = "default",
+        *,
+        start_layer: int,
+        end_layer: int,
+    ):
+        if layout not in _LAYOUTS:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "MiniMax NVFP4 HiCache supports layer_first, page_first, "
+                f"and page_first_direct layouts, got {layout!r}."
+            )
+        self.page_size = anchor_host.page_size
+        if self.page_size != buffer_info.page_size:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "MiniMax NVFP4 host/device page sizes must match, got "
+                f"{self.page_size} and {buffer_info.page_size}."
+            )
+        self.layout = layout
+        self.pin_memory = pin_memory
+        self.device = device
+        self.allocator = get_allocator_from_storage(allocator_type)
+        self.dtype = torch.uint8
+        self.start_layer = start_layer
+        self.end_layer = end_layer
+        self._configure_device_rows(buffer_info)
+        self.size = anchor_host.size
+        self.page_num = anchor_host.page_num
+        self.size_per_token = self.get_size_per_token()
+
+        requested_bytes = self.page_num * self.layer_num * self.row_bytes
+        available_bytes = host_memory_budget_bytes(requested_bytes)
+        if requested_bytes > available_bytes:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "Not enough host memory for MiniMax NVFP4 index cache. "
+                f"Requesting {requested_bytes / 1e9:.2f} GB but only have "
+                f"{available_bytes / 1e9:.2f} GB free."
+            )
+        logger.info(
+            f"Allocating {requested_bytes / 1e9:.2f} GB host memory for MiniMax "
+            f"NVFP4 index cache (layout={layout})."
+        )
+
+        self.kv_buffer = self.init_kv_buffer()
+        self.fd = getattr(self.allocator, "fd", None)
+        self.can_use_jit = False
+        self.can_use_write_back_jit = False
+        self.lock = threading.RLock()
+        self.clear()

+    # ----- layout ------------------------------------------------------------
+
+    def _configure_device_rows(self, buffer_info: PageRowBufferInfo) -> None:
+        buffer_info.validate()
+        self.target_layer_num = self.layer_num = len(buffer_info.rows)
+        self.row_bytes = buffer_info.row_bytes
+        self.device_rows = buffer_info.rows
+        self.device_slab = buffer_info.slab
+        self.device_num_pages = buffer_info.num_pages
+        self.device_slots = buffer_info.num_pages * buffer_info.page_size
+
+    @property
+    def page_bytes(self) -> int:
+        """Host bytes of one page across all layers."""
+        return self.layer_num * self.row_bytes
+
+    def get_size_per_token(self):
+        return self.page_bytes // self.page_size
+
+    def get_ksize_per_token(self):
+        return self.get_size_per_token()
+
+    def init_kv_buffer(self):
+        if self.layout == "layer_first":
+            dims = (self.layer_num, self.page_num, self.row_bytes)
+        else:
+            dims = (self.page_num, self.layer_num, 1, self.row_bytes)
+        alloc_func = ALLOC_MEMORY_FUNCS[self.device_slab.device.type]
+        return alloc_func(
+            dims,
+            dtype=self.dtype,
+            device=self.device,
+            pin_memory=self.pin_memory,
+            allocator=self.allocator,
+        )
+
+    def get_hybrid_pool_buffer(self):
+        return [self.kv_buffer]
+
+    def _host_layer_pages(self, layer_id: int) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """``[page_num, row_bytes]`` host rows of one layer (strided for page-first)."""
+        if self.layout == "layer_first":
+            return self.kv_buffer[layer_id]
+        return self.kv_buffer[:, layer_id, 0]
+
+    def _host_row_ids(self, layers: np.ndarray, pages: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
+        """Row ids into ``kv_buffer.view(-1, row_bytes)``, layer-major."""
+        layers, pages = layers[:, None], pages[None, :]
+        if self.layout == "layer_first":
+            return (layers * self.page_num + pages).reshape(-1)
+        return (pages * self.layer_num + layers).reshape(-1)
+
+    # ----- transfers -----------------------------------------------------------
+
+    def _init_page_row_transfer(self) -> None:
+        self._page_row_tables = None
+        device = self.device_rows[0].device
+        if not _is_cuda or device.type != "cuda" or not self.pin_memory:
+            return
+        from sglang.kernels.ops.kvcache.nvfp4_hicache import warmup_page_row_transfer
+
+        # The kernel IO backend has no fallback; fail at construction, not mid-serving.
+        warmup_page_row_transfer()
+        host_table = torch.tensor(
+            [self._host_layer_pages(i).data_ptr() for i in range(self.layer_num)],
+            dtype=torch.uint64,
+            device=device,
+        )
+        device_table = torch.tensor(
+            [rows.data_ptr() for rows in self.device_rows],
+            dtype=torch.uint64,
+            device=device,
+        )
+        # Pool buffers are stable for this host pool's lifetime.
+        self._page_row_tables = (host_table, device_table)
+        self._page_row_layer_tables = [
+            (host_table[i : i + 1], device_table[i : i + 1])
+            for i in range(self.layer_num)
+        ]
+        self._host_stride = self._host_layer_pages(0).stride(0)
+
+    def _copy_page_rows(self, tables, host_pages, device_pages, *, load):
+        from sglang.kernels.ops.kvcache.nvfp4_hicache import transfer_page_rows
+
+        transfer_page_rows(
+            *tables,
+            host_pages,
+            device_pages,
+            host_stride=self._host_stride,
+            device_stride=self.row_bytes,
+            row_bytes=self.row_bytes,
+            load=load,
+        )
+
+    def _page_indices(self, host_indices, device_indices):
+        if (
+            _is_cuda
+            and self.page_size == 128
+            and host_indices.is_cuda
+            and host_indices.device == device_indices.device
+        ):
+            from sglang.kernels.ops.kvcache.nvfp4_hicache import prepare_nvfp4_pages
+
+            return prepare_nvfp4_pages(
+                host_indices, device_indices, self.size, self.device_slots
+            )
+        if (
+            host_indices.ndim != 1
+            or device_indices.ndim != 1
+            or host_indices.numel() != device_indices.numel()
+            or host_indices.numel() % self.page_size
+        ):
+            raise ValueError(
+                "MiniMax NVFP4 HiCache transfers require equal, full-page index lists."
+            )
+        pages = []
+        for indices, capacity in (
+            (host_indices, self.size),
+            (device_indices, self.device_slots),
+        ):
+            if indices.dtype not in (torch.int32, torch.int64):
+                raise ValueError("MiniMax NVFP4 HiCache requires integer indices.")
+            rows = indices.reshape(-1, self.page_size)
+            starts = rows[:, 0]
+            valid = (
+                (starts % self.page_size == 0).all()
+                & (
+                    rows
+                    == starts[:, None]
+                    + torch.arange(self.page_size, device=indices.device)
+                ).all()
+                & (indices >= 0).all()
+                & (indices < capacity).all()
+            )
+            message = (
+                "MiniMax NVFP4 HiCache requires aligned, ordered, in-range full pages."
+            )
+            if indices.is_cuda:
+                torch._assert_async(valid, message)
+            elif not valid.item():
+                raise ValueError(message)
+            pages.append((starts // self.page_size).contiguous())
+        return tuple(pages)
+
+    def _copy_layer_pages(
+        self, layer_id, host_pages, device_pages, io_backend, *, load
+    ):
+        if io_backend not in ("kernel", "direct"):
+            raise ValueError(f"Unsupported IO backend: {io_backend}")
+        if host_pages.numel() == 0:
+            return
+        device = self.device_rows[layer_id]
+        if device.is_cuda:
+            if not self.pin_memory:
+                raise ValueError("MiniMax NVFP4 HiCache requires pinned host memory.")
+            if io_backend == "kernel":
+                self._copy_page_rows(
+                    self._page_row_layer_tables[layer_id],
+                    host_pages,
+                    device_pages,
+                    load=load,
+                )
+                return
+            self._copy_layer_pages_direct(layer_id, host_pages, device_pages, load=load)
+            return
+        # CPU reference path.
+        host = self._host_layer_pages(layer_id)
+        dst, src = (device, host) if load else (host, device)
+        dst_pages, src_pages = (
+            (device_pages, host_pages) if load else (host_pages, device_pages)
+        )
+        rows = src.index_select(0, src_pages.to(src.device)).to(dst.device)
+        dst.index_copy_(0, dst_pages.to(dst.device), rows)
+
+    def _copy_layer_pages_direct(self, layer_id, host_pages, device_pages, *, load):
+        hp, dp = host_pages.numpy(), device_pages.numpy()
+        host_rows = self._host_row_ids(np.array([layer_id]), hp)
+        host_starts, device_starts, lengths = _merge_ranges(host_rows, dp)
+        host = self.kv_buffer.view(-1, self.row_bytes)
+        device = self.device_rows[layer_id]
+        transfer_embedding_ranges_direct(
+            host if load else device,
+            device if load else host,
+            host_starts if load else device_starts,
+            device_starts if load else host_starts,
+            lengths,
+        )
+
+    def _transfer_page_indices(self, host_indices, device_indices, io_backend):
+        if io_backend not in ("kernel", "direct"):
+            raise ValueError(f"Unsupported IO backend: {io_backend}")
+        if io_backend == "direct":
+            # Prepare CPU range metadata once before enqueueing any DMA.
+            host_indices, device_indices = host_indices.cpu(), device_indices.cpu()

+    def load_to_device_per_layer(

+    def load_to_device_per_layer_physical(

+    def prepare_layer_loader(
+        self, device_pool, host_indices, device_indices, io_backend

+class MiniMaxDraftBackbone(DFlashDraftModel):
+    supports_fused_context_kv = False
+
+    def __init__(self, config, quant_config=None, prefix=""):
+        nn.Module.__init__(self)
+        self.config = config
+        self.is_nemotron_35_draft = False
+        self.embed_tokens = None
+        self.candidate_selector = None
+        self.block_size = config.block_size
+        self.num_context_features = len(config.dflash_config["target_layer_ids"])
+        norm = GemmaRMSNorm if config.use_gemma_norm else RMSNorm
+        with layer_stack():
+            self.layers = nn.ModuleList(
+                [
+                    DSparkMiniMaxLayer(
+                        DSparkMiniMaxDecoder(
+                            config=config,
+                            layer_id=i,
+                            quant_config=quant_config,
+                            prefix=f"language_model.model.dspark.layers.{i}.decoder_layer",
+                        )
+                    )
+                    for i in range(config.num_hidden_layers)
+                ]
+            )
+        self.norm = norm(config.hidden_size, eps=config.rms_norm_eps)
+        self.hidden_norm = norm(config.hidden_size, eps=config.rms_norm_eps)
+        # Each rank projects its hidden columns; the gather rebuilds the row.
+        self.fc = ColumnParallelLinear(
+            config.hidden_size * self.num_context_features,
+            config.hidden_size,
+            bias=False,
+            gather_output=False,
+            quant_config=quant_config,
+            prefix="language_model.model.dspark.fc",
+        )
+        # Rows are the injected target tokens, up to a prefill chunk.
+        self._fc_gatherer = MultimemAllGatherer(
+            max_tokens=recommended_max_tokens(include_prefill=True, floor=512)
+        )
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        input_ids: torch.Tensor,
+        positions: torch.Tensor,
+        forward_batch,
+        input_embeds: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+        get_embedding: bool = False,
+        pp_proxy_tensors=None,
+    ) -> LogitsProcessorOutput:
+        # DFlashDraftModel.forward threads (hidden, residual) through its layers;
+        # the target's decoder layers keep that pair on the forward batch's stream.
+        hidden_states = (
+            self.forward_embed(input_ids) if input_embeds is None else input_embeds
+        )
+        residual_batch.start(forward_batch)
+        for layer in self.layers:
+            hidden_states = layer(positions, hidden_states, forward_batch)
+        hidden_states = residual_batch.final_norm(
+            hidden_states, forward_batch, self.norm, skip_empty=True
+        )
+        return LogitsProcessorOutput(
+            next_token_logits=None, hidden_states=hidden_states
+        )
+
+    def project_target_hidden(self, target_hidden):
+        if target_hidden.shape[-1] != self.fc.input_size:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "DSpark target hidden features do not match checkpoint projection"
+            )
+        return self.hidden_norm(self._fc_gatherer(self.fc(target_hidden)[0]))

+            for n in (layer.self_attn.k_norm for layer in self.layers)

+    def _build_fused_kv_write_bundle(self, pool):

+            "method": method0,
+            "projection": SimpleNamespace(
+                weight=torch.cat(weights, dim=0),
+                weight_scale_inv_swizzled=torch.cat(scales),
+            ),
+            "widths": widths,
+        }

+
+    def _project_ctx_kv_stacked(self, *, ctx_hidden, positions, stacked):
+        kv_all = stacked["method"].apply(stacked["projection"], ctx_hidden)
+        ks, vs = [], []
+        for layer, kv in zip(self.layers, kv_all.split(stacked["widths"], dim=-1)):
+            attn = layer.self_attn
+            k, v = kv.split(attn.kv_size, dim=-1)
+            k = attn.apply_k_norm(k)
+            k = attn.apply_k_rope(positions, k)
+            ks.append(k.view(-1, attn.num_kv_heads, attn.head_dim))
+            vs.append(v.view(-1, attn.num_kv_heads, attn.head_dim))

+    def load_weights(self, weights):
+        self._mxfp8_ctx_kv_cache = False
+        # The fused write bundle snapshots stacked weights and k-norm multipliers.
+        self._fused_kv_write_cache = None
+        params = dict(self.named_parameters())
+        loaded = set()
+        loaded_shards = {}
+        prefixes = ("language_model.model.dspark.", "model.dspark.", "dspark.")
+        stacked = (
+            (".q_proj.", ".qkv_proj.", "q"),
+            (".k_proj.", ".qkv_proj.", "k"),
+            (".v_proj.", ".qkv_proj.", "v"),
+            (".gate_proj.", ".gate_up_proj.", 0),
+            (".up_proj.", ".gate_up_proj.", 1),

+        for raw_name, weight in weights:
+            name = next(
+                (raw_name[len(p) :] for p in prefixes if raw_name.startswith(p)), None
+            )
+            if name is None or "rotary_emb." in name:
+                continue
+            if name.startswith("confidence_head.") and self.confidence_head is None:
+                continue
+            name = name.replace("block_sparse_moe", "mlp").replace("final_norm", "norm")
+            shard = None
+            for source, target, shard_id in stacked:
+                if source in name:
+                    name = name.replace(source, target)
+                    shard = shard_id
+                    break

+                raise ValueError(f"Unexpected DSpark checkpoint tensor: {raw_name}")

+            loader = getattr(param, "weight_loader", default_weight_loader)
+            if shard is None:

+            else:
+                loader(param, weight, shard)

+            loaded.add(name)

+            name
+            for name, param in params.items()
+            if name not in loaded and not getattr(param, "_skip_weight_check", False)
+        }
+        if missing:
+            raise ValueError(f"Missing DSpark checkpoint tensors: {sorted(missing)}")
+        return loaded

+def _run_in_token_blocks(fn, x: torch.Tensor, block: int) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Apply a token-wise fn over blocks of the token dim (-2) and concatenate.
+
+    A long video yields hundreds of thousands of patch tokens, and the widened
+    intermediate for all of them at once can exceed the memory the KV pool
+    leaves. fn must be per-token (or per aligned token group). Every TP rank sees
+    the same tokens, so collectives inside fn run the same number of times.
+    """
+    n = x.shape[-2]
+    if block <= 0 or n <= block:
+        return fn(x)
+    return torch.cat([fn(x[..., i : i + block, :]) for i in range(0, n, block)], dim=-2)
+

+"""M3.1 resize policy with the public MiniMax image/video processors."""
+
+import numpy as np
+import torch
+from PIL import Image
+from transformers import MiniMaxM3VLImageProcessor, MiniMaxM3VLVideoProcessor
+
+
+def _resize_shape(height, width, max_size, factor):
+    def align(value):
+        return (value + factor - 1) // factor * factor
+
+    height, width = align(height), align(width)
+    max_height, max_width = max_size
+    if height > max_height or width > max_width:
+        new_height = min(height * max_height // height, height * max_width // width)
+        new_width = min(width * max_height // height, width * max_width // width)
+        height = align(max(new_height, factor))
+        width = align(max(new_width, factor))
+    return height, width
+
+
+class _MiniMaxM31Resize:
+    def __init__(self, *, max_size, **kwargs):
+        self.max_size = tuple(max_size)
+        super().__init__(**kwargs)
+
+    def resize_frames(self, tensor, size):
+        height, width = tensor.shape[-2:]
+        out_height, out_width = size
+        if (height, width) == (out_height, out_width):
+            return tensor
+        # Match the checkpoint's PIL bicubic interpolation.
+        frames = tensor.reshape(-1, tensor.shape[-3], height, width)
+        resized = []
+        for frame in frames:
+            pixels = frame.permute(1, 2, 0).cpu().to(torch.uint8)
+            image = Image.fromarray(pixels.numpy())
+            image = image.resize((out_width, out_height), Image.Resampling.BICUBIC)
+            resized.append(torch.from_numpy(np.array(image)).permute(2, 0, 1))
+        return (
+            torch.stack(resized)
+            .reshape(*tensor.shape[:-2], out_height, out_width)
+            .to(device=tensor.device, dtype=tensor.dtype)
+        )
+
+    def _resize_media(self, media, patch_size, merge_size):
+        result = []
+        for tensor in media:
+            height, width = tensor.shape[-2:]
+            out_height, out_width = _resize_shape(
+                height, width, self.max_size, patch_size * merge_size
+            )
+            result.append(self.resize_frames(tensor, (out_height, out_width)))
+        return result
+
+
+class MiniMaxM31ImageProcessor(_MiniMaxM31Resize, MiniMaxM3VLImageProcessor):
+    def _preprocess(self, images, do_resize, **kwargs):
+        if do_resize:
+            images = self._resize_media(

+DEVICE = torch.device("cuda")
+LAYERS, HEADS, HEAD_DIM, POOL, MAX_POS = 3, 2, 128, 64, 4096
+KV = HEADS * HEAD_DIM
+EPS = 1e-6
+
+
+class TestFusedKvNormRopeWrite(CustomTestCase):
+    def _run(self, *, rotary_dim, is_neox_style):
+        g = torch.Generator(device=DEVICE).manual_seed(rotary_dim)
+        bs, width = 3, 7
+        rows = bs * width
+        rope = get_rope(
+            HEAD_DIM,
+            rotary_dim=rotary_dim,
+            max_position=MAX_POS,
+            base=10_000_000,
+            is_neox_style=is_neox_style,
+        ).to(DEVICE)
+        norms = [GemmaRMSNorm(HEAD_DIM, eps=EPS).to(DEVICE) for _ in range(LAYERS)]
+        for norm in norms:
+            norm.weight.data.normal_(0, 0.1, generator=g)
+        kv = torch.randn(
+            rows, LAYERS * 2 * KV, device=DEVICE, dtype=torch.bfloat16, generator=g
+        )
+        positions = torch.randint(0, MAX_POS, (rows,), device=DEVICE, generator=g)
+        locs = torch.randperm(POOL, device=DEVICE, generator=g)[:rows]
+        commit_lens = torch.tensor([width, 3, 0], device=DEVICE, dtype=torch.int32)
+        k_bufs = [
+            torch.zeros(POOL, HEADS, HEAD_DIM, device=DEVICE, dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+            for _ in range(LAYERS)
+        ]
+        v_bufs = [torch.zeros_like(k) for k in k_bufs]
+        meta = torch.tensor(
+            [
+                [k.data_ptr(), v.data_ptr(), k.stride(0), v.stride(0)]
+                for k, v in zip(k_bufs, v_bufs)
+            ],
+            device=DEVICE,
+            dtype=torch.int64,
+        )
+        fused_kv_norm_rope_write(
+            kv,
+            meta,
+            torch.stack([1.0 + n.weight.float() for n in norms]),
+            rope.cos_sin_cache,
+            positions,
+            locs,
+            LAYERS,
+            KV,
+            HEAD_DIM,
+            EPS,
+            commit_lens=commit_lens,
+            locs_row_width=width,
+            is_neox_style=is_neox_style,
+            rotary_dim=rotary_dim,
+        )
+
+        committed = (
+            torch.arange(width, device=DEVICE)[None] < commit_lens[:, None]
+        ).reshape(-1)
+        view = kv.view(rows, LAYERS, 2, HEADS, HEAD_DIM)
+        for layer in range(LAYERS):
+            k = norms[layer].forward_native(view[:, layer, 0].reshape(-1, HEAD_DIM))
+            dummy_q = torch.zeros_like(k.view(rows, KV))
+            _, k = rope.forward_native(positions, dummy_q, k.view(rows, KV))
+            k = k.view(rows, HEADS, HEAD_DIM)
+            got_k, got_v = k_bufs[layer][locs], v_bufs[layer][locs]
+            torch.testing.assert_close(
+                got_k[committed], k[committed], atol=1.6e-2, rtol=1.6e-2
+            )
+            self.assertTrue(torch.equal(got_v[committed], view[committed, layer, 1]))
+            # rows past a request's commit length leave the pool untouched
+            self.assertEqual(got_k[~committed].abs().sum().item(), 0)
+            self.assertEqual(got_v[~committed].abs().sum().item(), 0)
+
+    def test_partial_rope_gemma_norm(self):
+        self._run(rotary_dim=64, is_neox_style=True)
+
+    def test_full_rope_interleaved(self):
+        self._run(rotary_dim=HEAD_DIM, is_neox_style=False)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()

+class _CPUController:

+    def __init__(self, allocator):
+        self.allocator = allocator

+        self.mem_pool_host = _CPUHostPool(
+            size=1024, dtype=torch.float32, device="cpu", kvcache=None, need_sort=False

+        self.layer_done_counter = SimpleNamespace(
+            producer_index=-1,

+        )
+        self.load_queue = []
+        self.ack_load_queue = []

+    def write(self, device_indices, node_id, extra_pools, flush=True):
+        self.ack_write_queue.append(HiCacheAck(_Event(), _Event(), [node_id]))
+        return self.mem_pool_host.alloc(len(device_indices))

+    def load(self, host_indices, node_id, extra_pools):
+        indices = self.allocator.alloc(len(host_indices))
+        if indices is not None:
+            self.load_queue.append(node_id)

+        if not self.load_queue:

+        counter = self.layer_done_counter
+        counter.producer_index = (counter.producer_index + 1) % counter.num_counters
+        event = counter.events[counter.producer_index].finish_event
+        assert event.done
+        event.done = False
+        self.ack_load_queue.append(HiCacheAck(_Event(), event, self.load_queue[:]))

+        ]._full_kv_pool_host = self.controller.mem_pool_host

+    def _insert(self, length):
+        key = RadixKey(self.tokens[:length])
+        slots = self.allocator.alloc(length)
+        result = self.cache.insert(InsertParams(key=key, value=slots))
+        self.allocator.free(slots[: result.prefix_len])
+        return self.cache.match_prefix(MatchPrefixParams(key=key)).last_device_node

+    def _backup(self, node):
+        action = self.cache.tree_core.build_backup_kv_action(node)

+    def _request(self, index, length=384):
+        req = Req(
+            rid=str(index),
+            origin_input_text="",
+            origin_input_ids=self.tokens[:length],
+            sampling_params=SamplingParams(max_new_tokens=8),
+        )

+        result = match_kv_cache(req, self.cache, req.origin_input_ids)
+        req.lock = self.cache.lock(result.last_device_node)
+        pm = self.queue._build_decode_prefix_match(req, result)
+        self.pool.write((index, slice(0, pm.l1_prefix_len)), pm.prefix_indices)
+        return DecodeRequest(
+            req=req,
+            kv_receiver=SimpleNamespace(poll=lambda: KVPoll.Success),
+            prefix_match=pm,

+    @staticmethod
+    def _run_with_loop_handshake(make_awaitable):
+        """The hook blocks until a coroutine on the event loop answers it, so a hook
+        that holds the loop thread starves that coroutine and times out."""
+        started, answered = threading.Event(), threading.Event()
+
+        def wait_for_loop():
+            started.set()
+            if not answered.wait(timeout=5):
+                raise TimeoutError("the preprocess hook blocked the event loop")
+
+        async def answer():
+            while not started.is_set():
+                await asyncio.sleep(0.001)
+            answered.set()
+
+        async def run():
+            responder = asyncio.create_task(answer())
+            result = await make_awaitable(wait_for_loop)
+            await asyncio.wait_for(responder, timeout=5)
+            return result
+
+        return asyncio.run(run())
+

+    pool = make_pool()
+    for sub_pool, components in (
+        (pool.main_pool, ("k_buffer", "k_scale_buffer", "v_buffer", "v_scale_buffer")),
+        (pool.index_k_pool, ("k_buffer", "k_scale_buffer")),

+        assert sub_pool.get_kv_size_bytes() == (sub_pool.slab.nbytes, 0)
+        end = 0
+        for name in components:
+            for layer, view in enumerate(getattr(sub_pool, name)):
+                row = sub_pool.rows[layer]
+                offset = view.data_ptr() - row.data_ptr()
+                assert view.stride(0) == sub_pool.row_bytes
+                assert offset % 128 == 0 and offset >= end
+                assert offset + view[0].nbytes <= sub_pool.row_bytes
+            end = offset + view[0].nbytes
+        # Components never overlap: filling each view sets exactly its own bytes.
+        sub_pool.slab.zero_()
+        for name in components:
+            for view in getattr(sub_pool, name):
+                view.add_(1)
+        assert int(sub_pool.slab.max()) == 1
+        assert int(sub_pool.slab.long().sum()) == sum(

+class CaptureLayer(nn.Module):
+    """Adds ``1 + offset`` to the residual stream, writing it with nothing pending,
+    so a capture at the layer's entry reads the full stream value."""
+
+    def __init__(self, offset=0):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.offset = offset

+    def forward(
+        self, *, hidden_states, forward_batch, captured_last_layer_outputs, **kwargs
+    ):
+        if captured_last_layer_outputs is not None:
+            captured_last_layer_outputs.capture(hidden_states)
+        return residual_batch.set_written(
+            hidden_states + 1 + self.offset, forward_batch
+        )
+

+class TestMiniMaxM31Resize(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_aligned_size(self):
+        for (height, width, cap), expected in (
+            # The cap rounds down to the factor: 500 -> 476.
+            ((2000, 2000, 500), (476, 476)),
+            # A short side under 112 is enlarged to 112.
+            ((50, 100, 1008), (112, 224)),
+            # Shrinking a long side over the cap takes precedence over the short-side floor.
+            ((50, 2000, 1008), (28, 1008)),
+            # An upscale that would push the long side past the cap stops at the cap.
+            ((50, 1000, 1008), (56, 1008)),
+            # Sides round to the nearest factor; floor would give 980.
+            ((345, 1000, 1008), (336, 1008)),
+        ):

+def _config(**overrides):
+    fields = dict(
+        hidden_size=8,
+        intermediate_size=4,
+        num_hidden_layers=2,
+        num_attention_heads=2,
+        num_key_value_heads=1,

+            conv_group_size=2,

+    )
+    fields.update(overrides)
+    return PretrainedConfig(**fields)

+def _load_norm(norm):
+    weight = torch.linspace(-0.4, 0.6, norm.weight.numel())
+    loader = getattr(norm.weight, "weight_loader", dflash.default_weight_loader)
+    loader(norm.weight, weight)
+
+
+def _reference_norm(x, norm, gemma):
+    scale = norm.weight.float() + (1.0 if gemma else 0.0)
+    normalized = x.float() * torch.rsqrt(
+        x.float().square().mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True) + norm.variance_epsilon
+    )
+    return (normalized * scale).to(x.dtype)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("gemma", [False, True])
+def test_every_backbone_norm_uses_checkpoint_convention(gemma):
+    # Omit the new flag entirely for the existing Qwen-style default.
+    model = dflash.DFlash2DraftModel(
+        _config(
+            partial_rotary_factor=1.0,
+            **({"use_gemma_norm": True} if gemma else {}),
+        )
+    )
+    norms = [model.norm, model.hidden_norm]
+    for layer in model.layers:
+        norms.extend(
+            [
+                layer.input_layernorm,
+                layer.post_attention_layernorm,
+                layer.self_attn.q_norm,
+                layer.self_attn.k_norm,
+            ]
+        )
+    for norm in norms:
+        assert type(norm) is (GemmaRMSNorm if gemma else RMSNorm)
+        _load_norm(norm)
+        x = torch.arange(1, 3 * norm.weight.numel() + 1, dtype=torch.float32).reshape(
+            3, -1
+        )
+        torch.testing.assert_close(norm(x), _reference_norm(x, norm, gemma))
+    assert model.supports_fused_context_kv is (not gemma)
+    # Full RoPE would otherwise admit the RMSNorm-only fused table path.
+    assert all(
+        layer.self_attn.use_table_qk_norm_rope is (not gemma) for layer in model.layers
+    )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("gemma", [False, True])
+def test_context_projection_uses_the_same_norm_convention(gemma):

+    _load_norm(model.hidden_norm)
+    with torch.no_grad():
+        model.fc.weight.copy_(torch.arange(128).reshape(8, 16) / 128)
+    context = torch.linspace(-2, 3, 48).reshape(3, 16)
+    expected = _reference_norm(

+    )

+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "activation,alpha,limit",
+    [("silu", 1.0, 7.0), ("swigluoai", 1.702, 7.0), ("swigluoai", 0.75, 2.5)],
+)
+def test_mlp_matches_activation_formula_including_saturated_inputs(
+    activation, alpha, limit
+):
+    mlp = dflash.DFlashMLP(
+        _config(hidden_act=activation, swiglu_alpha=alpha, swiglu_limit=limit)
+    )
+    with torch.no_grad():
+        mlp.gate_up_proj.weight.copy_(torch.eye(8))
+        mlp.down_proj.weight.copy_(torch.arange(32).reshape(8, 4) / 32)
+    x = torch.tensor(
+        [
+            [-12.0, -2.0, 2.0, 12.0, -12.0, -1.0, 1.0, 12.0],
+            [12.0, 0.2, -0.2, -12.0, 12.0, -12.0, 12.0, -12.0],
+        ]
+    )
+    gate, up = x.chunk(2, dim=-1)
+    if activation == "swigluoai":
+        gate = gate.clamp(max=limit)
+        up = up.clamp(min=-limit, max=limit)
+        activated = gate * torch.sigmoid(alpha * gate) * (up + 1)
+    else:
+        activated = F.silu(gate) * up
+    expected = F.linear(activated, mlp.down_proj.weight)

+
+def _reference_partial_rope(x, positions, head_dim=4):
+    # This config rotates the first two coordinates of each four-wide head.
+    heads = x.reshape(x.shape[0], -1, head_dim)
+    first, second = heads[..., 0], heads[..., 1]
+    angle = positions.float()[:, None]
+    rotated = torch.stack(
+        (
+            first * angle.cos() - second * angle.sin(),
+            second * angle.cos() + first * angle.sin(),
+        ),
+        dim=-1,
+    )
+    return torch.cat((rotated, heads[..., 2:]), dim=-1).reshape_as(x)
+

+    torch.testing.assert_close(actual_q, _reference_partial_rope(q, positions))
+    torch.testing.assert_close(actual_k, _reference_partial_rope(k, positions))

+    # Only replace the serving attention backend; normalization, RoPE and all

+        handle_missing_default_values(args)
+        declare_resolution(args, "minimax", **_minimax_m3_overrides(args, NVFP4))
+        _resolve_dflash_draft_attention_backend(args)
+    assert resolution_result(args, "speculative_draft_attention_backend") == expected
+

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("algorithm", ["DSPARK", "DFLASH"])
+def test_both_algorithms_require_pp_one(algorithm):

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("mode", ["prefill", "decode"])
+def test_dflash_colocation_guard_preserves_dspark_disaggregation(mode):
+    overrides = _minimax_m3_overrides(
+        _args(speculative_algorithm="DSPARK", disaggregation_mode=mode), NVFP4
+    )
+    assert overrides["speculative_draft_attention_backend"] == "trtllm_mha"

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("algorithm", ["DSPARK", "DFLASH"])
+def test_both_algorithms_admit_hicache(algorithm):

+        _args(speculative_algorithm=algorithm, enable_hierarchical_cache=True), NVFP4
+    )
+    assert overrides["speculative_draft_kv_cache_dtype"] == "bf16"
+    assert overrides["page_size"] == 128

+def test_dflash_hicache_restores_draft_kv_through_a_sidecar():
+    # A host restore that skipped the draft pool would leave stale draft KV:
+    # serving stays correct but the accept length silently drops.
+    draft_pool = object()
+    draft_runner = SimpleNamespace(
+        token_to_kv_pool=draft_pool,
+        model_config=SimpleNamespace(
+            hf_config=SimpleNamespace(architectures=["MiniMaxDFlash2DraftModel"]),
+            num_nextn_predict_layers=0,
+        ),
+    )
+    worker = SimpleNamespace(
+        target_worker=SimpleNamespace(
+            model_runner=SimpleNamespace(spec_algorithm=SpeculativeAlgorithm.DFLASH)
+        ),
+        draft_worker=SimpleNamespace(model_runner=draft_runner),
+    )
+    worker._draft_model_runners = lambda: BaseSpecWorker._draft_model_runners(worker)
+    with get_context().override_server_args(enable_hierarchical_cache=True):
+        plan = BaseSpecWorker._build_hicache_draft_plan(worker)
+    assert plan.mode == HiCacheDraftMode.SIDECAR
+    assert plan.device_pools == (draft_pool,)

+def test_dflash_requires_blackwell_and_static_verification(monkeypatch):
+    with (
+        override_platform(is_blackwell=False),

+    ):
+        _minimax_m3_overrides(_args(), NVFP4)
+    monkeypatch.setenv("SGLANG_RAGGED_VERIFY_MODE", "compact")
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="SGLANG_RAGGED_VERIFY_MODE=static"):
+        _minimax_m3_overrides(_args(), NVFP4)

+class _CaptureLayer(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(self, offset=0):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.offset = offset
+
+    def forward(
+        self, *, hidden_states, forward_batch, captured_last_layer_outputs, **kwargs
+    ):
+        if captured_last_layer_outputs is not None:
+            captured_last_layer_outputs.capture(hidden_states)
+        return residual_batch.set_written(
+            hidden_states + 1 + self.offset, forward_batch
+        )
+
+
+class _OffsetNorm(nn.Module):
+    def forward(self, hidden_states, residual=None):
+        if residual is None:
+            return hidden_states + 100
+        return hidden_states + residual + 100, residual
+
+
+def _capture_model():
+    model = object.__new__(MiniMaxM3Model)
+    nn.Module.__init__(model)
+    model.pp_group = SimpleNamespace(is_first_rank=True, is_last_rank=True)
+    model.layers = nn.ModuleList(
+        [_CaptureLayer(offset=10), _CaptureLayer(), _CaptureLayer()]
+    )
+    model.norm = _OffsetNorm()
+    model.finalize_norm = None
+    model.start_layer, model.end_layer = 0, 3
+    model.layers_to_capture = []
+    wrapper = object.__new__(MiniMaxM3SparseForConditionalGeneration)
+    nn.Module.__init__(wrapper)
+    wrapper.pp_group, wrapper.model = model.pp_group, model
+    return wrapper
+
+
+def test_dflash_captures_selected_layer_outputs_before_final_norm():
+    wrapper = _capture_model()
+    wrapper.set_dflash_layers_to_capture([0, 2])
+    assert wrapper.capture_aux_hidden_states
+    with patch(
+        "sglang.srt.models.minimax_m3.check_cuda_graph_backend", return_value=True
+    ):
+        output, captured = wrapper.model(
+            torch.tensor([0]),
+            torch.tensor([0]),
+            SimpleNamespace(can_run_tbo=False),
+            input_embeds=torch.zeros(1, 2),
+        )
+    assert len(captured) == 2
+    torch.testing.assert_close(captured[0], torch.full((1, 2), 11.0))
+    torch.testing.assert_close(captured[1], torch.full((1, 2), 13.0))
+    torch.testing.assert_close(output, torch.full((1, 2), 113.0))
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("ids", [[], [2, 0], [0, 0], [-1], [3]])
+def test_dflash_rejects_invalid_taps_without_changing_capture(ids):
+    wrapper = _capture_model()
+    wrapper.set_dflash_layers_to_capture([0, 2])
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        wrapper.set_dflash_layers_to_capture(ids)
+    assert wrapper.model.layers_to_capture == [1, 3]
+    assert [layer._is_layer_to_capture for layer in wrapper.model.layers] == [
+        False,
+        True,
+        False,
+    ]
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(pytest.main([__file__, "-v"]))
